nodes.answer: The samples were precipitated via the chloroform-methanol method.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Water purification techniques|Chemical precipitation_qna_002
nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: How does the wet scrubber affect the chemical composition of particles that pass through it?
nodes.answer: The scrubber has little effect on reducing the health and environmental impacts of remaining particles, as changes in particle composition are minimal, primarily involving sulfate uptake, diffusion-driven uptake of ultrafine particles, and wet deposition of coarse particles.
